1456-4460-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-5933.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2403-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

330-2429-5346.notablePrerequisites: Your commander is on the battlefield as a creature and has deathtouch.
330-2429-5346.description:
When an opponent controls a creature, activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to the targeted creature and destroying it due to your commander's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat as desired.
330-2429-5346.notes: This loop can be repeated provided you have {1} available to start the loop (which you'll get back from Crime Novelist). Simply hold onto the Treasure for future loops as desired.

3951-4192-5703-7824.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4192-5703-7824.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1580-4556-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-6633.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2397-3821-4415.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
2397-3821-4415.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1368-4460-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4460-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

6006-6791-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-6791-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-6791-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-1753-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1753-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

618-4759.description:
Activate the mutated Archipelagore and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

5413-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-5056-7308.description:
Cause Mona Lisa to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-4131-7290.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-4131-7290.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Does Machines.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4681-5170-6273.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

549-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

630-2366-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5539-6993.description:
Whenever an opponent controls a nonblack creature, if you control a Treasure, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Attrition by paying {B} and sacrificing Lucius, targeting a nonblack creature an opponent controls.
When Lucius dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Lucius trigger, exiling it from your graveyard and targeting the creature that Attrition is targeting.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Attrition trigger, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Lucius triggers, returning it from exile to the battlefield under your control.
Repeat as needed.

1818-2173-5010-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1414-1456-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-1456-2854-4574.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

586-5060-5256-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-5060-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

104-3188-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-5686.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1117-2866-3497-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-2743-6669.easyPrerequisites: You are able to defeat Invasion of Alara.
111-2743-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to then exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstroms, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

813-2103-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Displace.
813-2103-3647.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1029-1355-5028.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
1029-1355-5028.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Sanctum Weaver.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1355-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1090-5231-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-5231-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
2292-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1323-1606-3360.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Torchling and Ley Weaver each have at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {R}.
1323-1606-3360.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Torchling's first ability by paying {R}, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.
You may tap an additional land each cycle to get infinite mana, and you may then use Experiment Kraj's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

864-2281-4191-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

3388-3607-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding one mana of any color.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with two +1/+1 counters on it and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2034-2744-3026-4302.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Angel, adding {C}{C}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
The Spirit token becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1424-3957-5213.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
1424-3957-5213.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Trespasser's Curse, gaining you 1 life and losing you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

391-3230-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3230-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
